root_cause: Two canonical recovery jobs started on every minute boundary, creating permanent baseline concurrency.
The data-spine watchdog shared commercial-heartbeat minute zero, and revenue-attribution shared every 15-minute slot with the revenue-intelligence snapshot.
Provider logs recorded repeated pg_cron job startup timeout events and management/PostgREST statement timeouts while application 500s had already been removed.
prevention: Dephase the reconciliation worker to a 59-second interval while keeping its canonical job active.
Move the data-spine watchdog away from commercial-heartbeat minutes without reducing its ten-minute cadence.
Move revenue-attribution away from the revenue-intelligence snapshot without reducing its fifteen-minute cadence.
Require exact cron.job schedule readback in the migration.
Do not disable canonical runtime owners or weaken commercial heartbeat cadence.
